diceDesc.ember: In Weapons it deals +2 while your build carries 4 or more Red items.
diceDesc.cinder: In Weapons, a max roll sets Burn 1 on the target.
diceDesc.frostplate: In Shields it adds 2 extra shield once you carry 4 or more Shieldwall items.
diceDesc.gyro: Its faces are 2, 3, 3, 4, 4 and 5; once per battle, flip to the opposite face.
diceDesc.coil: Faces are 2·2·3·3. +1 when it repeats last turn's value, and +2 more while you own 3+ [swarm].
diceDesc.sprout: Grows +1 on a max face (up to +2), and resolving it in Engines grows it again, up to +4.
diceDesc.vulture: Max face pays 8 scrap and adds 1 to the payout count; from the second payout on it crits in a weapon slot.
diceDesc.ashen: On a min roll, the next black die this turn gets +2.
diceDesc.obsidian: Rolls only 1 or 8; placed on a 1 it counts as 8 — for 2 hull.
diceDesc.copycat: Faces are only 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4; once per battle, copy the higher of its two neighbours.
diceDesc.ballast: Once per battle, set its face aside: next turn it starts on the stored value instead of rolling.
diceDesc.coreshard: Prismatic dice may exceed any slot cap for 1 hull. A max face primes every school by +2.
diceDesc.flare: Its faces are 1, 2, 4 and 4 — never a 3 — and in Weapons it deals +1 on 3 or more.
diceDesc.magma: In Weapons, a max face applies Burn 3.
diceDesc.thermite: +2 in Weapons while hull is under half; once per battle it splits into two temporary grey d4s.
diceDesc.lancehead: +3 in the Spinal Mount, and a natural 15 or more there crits.
diceDesc.hoarfrost: +1 shield whenever it fills a shield slot.
diceDesc.aegis: In Shields it counts +2, and the wall holds: next turn you gain 3 shield for free.
diceDesc.glacierspike: Its faces are 8 to 20, so the Spinal Mount can never jam it; wherever it resolves it grants 3 shield, and from the Spinal Mount it also jams the target.
diceDesc.tendon: +2 when it repeats last turn's value, and primes the next green die by +1.
diceDesc.bramble: Grows +2 on a max face (up to +2), and resolving it in Weapons grows it again, up to +4.
diceDesc.heartwood: +2 in Engines. Once per battle you may bank its face for the next turn.
diceDesc.worldseed: Grows +1 on a max face, up to +4, and a max face resolves its slot twice.
diceDesc.token: Max face pays 3 scrap and adds 1 to the battle's payout count.
diceDesc.glint: A 1 or a 6 pays 2 scrap and adds 1 to the battle's payout count.
diceDesc.bonanza: Its faces are two 2s, a 4, a 6 and two 8s; an 8 adds 1 to the payout count, and from the third payout on it pays 4 scrap and 1 charge wherever it resolves.
diceDesc.jackpot: Max face pays 6 scrap and 1 charge and adds 1 to the payout count; from the fourth payout on a max face pays 12 scrap more.
diceDesc.midas: Each turn ends with 1 scrap for every [scrap] item you own; its max face adds 2 to the payout count, and from the third payout on it resolves at +3.
diceDesc.cinderblack: Rolls only 1 or 4; a 1 stores 1 charge.
diceDesc.tar: +1 while hull is under 50%, and +3 more while it is under 25%.
diceDesc.nadir: Min face primes the next black die with +3.
diceDesc.eclipse: Any die fits the reactor over the cap — for 1 hull; once per battle it banks its face for the next turn.
diceDesc.abyss: Its faces are only 1 or 12; once it has resolved a 1, every 12 it resolves counts as 18.
diceDesc.shim: Faces are only 2, 2, 3, 3; +1 on the first turn of a battle.
diceDesc.spool: A roll of 1 or 2 is rerolled once.
diceDesc.mimic: Once per battle, swap values with any other die; with three items tagged «dice», every battle starts with a free nudge.
diceDesc.pivot: Faces are only 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8 — no middle ground; once per battle, flip to the opposite face.
diceDesc.beaconChip: +2 in Sensors, and every battle starts with one free nudge.
diceDesc.lodestar: +1 in every slot; every battle starts with one free nudge and one extra reroll; once per battle, set its face aside for the next turn.
diceDesc.prismChip: Its faces are 2, 3, 3 and 4; a max face pays 2 scrap for every prismatic item you carry.
diceDesc.prismCore: It refracts forward: in Sensors it primes red, in Weapons blue, in Shields green, in Engines black, in the Reactor yellow — that school's next die this turn gets +2.
diceDesc.spectra: Max face pays 2 charge and 4 scrap; once per battle it banks its face and starts next turn on it.
diceDesc.aurora: +2 in every slot while the deck holds 3 or more prismatic dice; a roll of 10 or higher pays 2 damage, 2 shield, 1 charge, 3 scrap and 1 hull.
diceDesc.fate-d100: Never slotted. Once per battle, roll it and take what the sector gives.
diceDesc.red-d6: Faces 1 to 6 and no passive — the plain red workhorse the rest of the deck is measured against.
diceDesc.blue-d6: Faces 1 to 6 and no passive — plain blue, but it still counts toward blue resonance.
diceDesc.grey-d4: Faces 1 to 4 and no passive — cheap grey filler, and one more body for decks that count small dice.
diceDesc.green-d4: Faces 1 to 4 and no passive — cheap green filler that feeds engine and sensor thresholds.
diceDesc.yellow-d6: Faces 1 to 6 and no passive — plain yellow; the luck has to come from what you build around it.
diceDesc.black-d6: Faces 1 to 6 and no passive — plain black, and it takes no risks on its own.
diceDesc.slag: Its faces are 1, 1, 1 and 4, but in the reactor it always counts as 4.
diceDesc.fissure: Rolls only 1, 2, 3, 8, 9 or 10; once per battle it splits into two temporary grey d4s.
diceDesc.anthracite: Rolls only 1, 1, 2, 11, 12 or 12; once per battle it swaps values with another die.
diceDesc.stillwater: Its faces are only 3, 3, 4, 4, 5 and 5; in Sensors it jams the target even on a 3.
diceDesc.floodgate: Its faces are 3 to 8, never lower; once per battle it banks its face, and next turn it starts there instead of rolling.
diceDesc.undertow: It never resolves below 5; once per battle, swap its value with any other die.
diceDesc.fused-emberforge: Two blanks struck into one: its faces are 2, 2, 4, 4, 6, 6, 8, 8 and never odd.
diceDesc.fused-frostwall: Two plates welded flat: its faces are 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6.
diceDesc.fused-counterweight: Once per battle, trade values with any other die.
diceDesc.fused-seedling: At the start of every battle it puts out a shoot: a temporary green d4 for 2 turns.
diceDesc.fused-goldvein: The vein runs twice through the last face — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 8 — and a max roll pays 4 scrap.
diceDesc.fused-voidcore: Once per battle, break it apart: it burns out and leaves two temporary grey d4s.
diceDesc.fused-pyroclast: A max face in Weapons throws a second stone for 3 damage past the slot cap.
diceDesc.fused-keel: Once per battle, bank this face: next turn the die starts on it instead of rolling.
diceDesc.fused-tendril: +2 when it repeats last turn's value or rolls its minimum.
diceDesc.fused-windfall: Max face pays 3 scrap, min face pays 1.
diceDesc.fused-railslug: +1 in weapons and +2 in the Spinal Mount.
diceDesc.fused-rampart: +1 in shields, and while you already hold 8 shield it adds 2 more.
diceDesc.fused-bloom: Grows +1 on a max face, up to +3, and any roll of 9 or more repairs 1 hull.
diceDesc.taproot: Digs in each time it resolves: +1 from the third slot of the battle, +2 from the fifth.
diceDesc.seedpod: A max face spawns a temporary green d4 for two turns. Once per battle you may split it into two grey d4s.
diceDesc.evergreen: Faces are only even: 2·4·6·8·10·12. Grows +2 on a max face, up to +4.
diceDesc.chaff: Faces are only 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8; once per battle, burn it from the tray for two temporary grey d4.
diceDesc.glimmer: Its faces are only 1, 1, 4 and 4; while the deck holds 2 or more prismatic dice, a rolled 1 rerolls itself once.
diceDesc.facet: Its faces are 4, 4, 5, 5, 6 and 6; once per battle it trades values with any other die.
diceDesc.gamut: Faces are 2·4·6·8·10·10. +2 while you own 2+ [spike]; a max face banks 1 charge per prismatic die in your deck.
diceDesc.salvo: In Weapons it deals 1 extra damage for every Swarm item in your build, itself included.
diceDesc.crucible: Once per battle, bank its face: next turn it starts on that number instead of rolling.
diceDesc.bombard: Its faces are 1, 2, 3, 4, 12 and 12; a 12 in Weapons deals 5 extra damage.
diceDesc.smallChange: Its faces are two 2s, two 3s and two 4s; once per battle it breaks into two grey d4s for the rest of the fight.
diceDesc.wager: Its faces are three 1s and three 6s; once per battle it exchanges values with another die, and a 1 in a weapon slot becomes a 6 for 2 hull.
diceDesc.hedge: Rolls only 1, 3, 5 or 7; once per battle it banks its face and starts the next turn on it.

resonance.red-6: The first Weapons slot resolves twice.
resonance.blue-2: +1 to every blue die's minimum roll.
resonance.blue-6: Once per turn, a blue die can't roll below average.
resonance.green-2: A die repeating last turn's value gets +2.
resonance.green-4: End of battle: heal 1 per green die.
resonance.green-6: A green die on max grows +1 for the run (up to +3).

resonance.black-4: A min-face black roll maxes the next black die.
resonance.black-6: Once per battle, survive a lethal hit at 1 hull.
resonance.grey-4: Grey dice may copy an adjacent value.

perksDesc.warmup: From turn 3 on, every weapon hit deals 3 extra damage.

perksDesc.reflector: End a turn holding 10+ shield and the field lashes back for 4 damage.

perksDesc.coin: +3 scrap at battle start, and every die that resolves on its highest or lowest face pays 1 more.
perksDesc.blood-reactor: Once per turn, pay 2 hull for +3 charge; with four charge items owned, every reactor die stores 2 more.
perksDesc.sacrifice: Burn a die to pool +4 weapon damage this turn; under a third hull every weapon slot crits ×1.5.
perksDesc.back-door: A min-face black roll grants +6 scrap.
perksDesc.spare: The lowest die of each roll comes up one higher; reroll one more die at a time.
perksDesc.afterburner: Engine thresholds are one step easier; hull −2.
perksDesc.jammer-plus: Jam cuts the enemy attack by 2 more, but marks are worth 1 less.
perksDesc.targeter: Marks are worth +1 more damage, but jam cuts 1 less.
perksDesc.plating: Hull +5, and every won battle repairs 2 hull.
perksDesc.scorchmark: Max face in weapons adds Burn 1.
perksDesc.openingVolley: +2 in weapons on the first two turns.
perksDesc.pyreFloor: A red die that rolls its lowest face is rerolled at once.
perksDesc.redForge: A red weapon die on its max face gains +1 to its faces, up to +2.
perksDesc.searing: A weapon roll of 8 or more adds Burn 2.
perksDesc.cinderTithe: Max face in weapons pays 3 scrap.
perksDesc.thermalVent: +3 in weapons on a max face, and 1 charge.
perksDesc.overburn: Weapon dice get +2, and each turn ends by burning 1 hull while you are above half hull.
perksDesc.emberField: Max face on a red die adds Burn 2.
perksDesc.hotline: Any die fits the Spinal Mount past its cap, for 2 hull.
perksDesc.secondBarrel: +3 in Weapons B, and +2 more from Mk II.
perksDesc.detonator: A max face in weapons resolves the slot twice, and with five weapon items any roll of 8 or more does too.
perksDesc.magmaCore: +3 in weapons at red resonance 4, and at red 6 every weapon hit hands the next red die +3.
perksDesc.infernoDoctrine: Every weapon hit adds Burn 1, and Burn 3 once you own three burn sources.
perksDesc.stormWall: Max face in shields grants 3 more shield.
perksDesc.coldStart: Each of the first two turns ends with 3 more shield.
perksDesc.meltwater: Min face in shields grants 3 more shield.
perksDesc.chillBank: Max face on a blue die stores 1 charge.
perksDesc.aegisField: The first slot to resolve each turn also raises 3 shield.
perksDesc.deepFreeze: A shields die at 8+ reads +3 and adds 2 more shield.
perksDesc.interdict: A sensors die under 4 is raised to 4, so it always jams, and your jam cuts 1 more.
perksDesc.hardVacuum: +3 in shields while hull is under half.
perksDesc.secondSkin: Hull +4 and 2 hull repaired after every battle, but salvage pays 10% less.
perksDesc.glacierPact: +4 in shields once you hold four blue dice.
perksDesc.mirrorLattice: Dodges reflect damage, engine thresholds are one step easier, and with three Dodge items engines read +3.
perksDesc.permafrost: A max face in shields resolves the slot twice.
perksDesc.rootHold: From turn three on, every die in engines counts as two higher.
perksDesc.secondGrowth: +2 when a die repeats last turn's value.
perksDesc.pollen: Max face on a green die heals 1 hull.
perksDesc.longRoots: A die that lands on its maximum face permanently gains +1, up to +2.
perksDesc.greenwake: 5 or more in engines grants 2 shield.
perksDesc.sapline: Repeating last turn's value heals 2 hull.
perksDesc.bloomCycle: +3 when a green die repeats last turn's value.
perksDesc.photosynth: Every green die that resolves stores 1 charge.
perksDesc.evergreen: While you carry three growth items, a die that repeats last turn's value permanently gains +1, up to +3.
perksDesc.tideRoots: Interference tide hits one level softer.
perksDesc.worldTree: Once four green dice resonate, every turn ends healing 1 hull per green item you carry.
perksDesc.overgrowthPact: Growth +2 and hull −4; while you carry four growth items, every die counts as 2 higher.
perksDesc.standingWave: Engine thresholds one step easier; 6 or more in engines carries 4 shield and 2 charge into the next turn.
perksDesc.pocketChange: Entering a node pays 1 scrap for each [scrap] item in your loadout.
perksDesc.streetPrice: Shops −8%, but scrap gains −5%: you buy and sell at the same street price.
perksDesc.goldTooth: Every yellow die you resolve pays 1 scrap.
perksDesc.tallyMark: Each victory cuts a tally mark; from the sixth on, every node you enter pays 3 scrap.
perksDesc.bountyBoard: Every victory pays a bounty of 12 scrap.
perksDesc.marketRun: Shops −10%; the first reroll in each shop is free.
perksDesc.goldRush: Max face on a yellow die pays 8 scrap.
perksDesc.houseEdge: A die resolving at 7 or more in weapons lands a crit (×1.5 damage).
perksDesc.ledgerTrick: +20% scrap, but the charge cap drops by 2.
perksDesc.mintCondition: Once you carry four yellow dice, every max face pays 10 scrap and 2 charge.
perksDesc.silentPartner: Shops −12% with one free reroll each, and every victory pays 4 scrap per [scrap] item you own.
perksDesc.veinTap: +40% scrap, but every reroll takes one die fewer.
perksDesc.darkCurrent: A die under 5 in the reactor counts as 2 higher.
perksDesc.lowTide: Every die that rolls its min face banks 1 charge, placed or not.
perksDesc.brinkmanship: +1 to every resolved die once you own three risk items.
perksDesc.blackTithe: Every node you enter pays 5 scrap for 1 hull, and stops billing below 25% hull.
perksDesc.coldFusion: Charge cap +4; the core eats 15% of your scrap.
perksDesc.longOdds: +3 on a min face from a black die.
perksDesc.nightShift: Max face in the reactor stores 2 more charge.
perksDesc.eventHorizon: +3 for black dice in the reactor.
perksDesc.bloodPrice: At the end of each turn, while hull is 30% or higher, spend 1 hull to deal 4 damage.
perksDesc.heatShroud: The first reactor overflow each battle costs no hull, and a reactor die raises 4 shield while you hold 8 or more charge.
perksDesc.scrapheap: Every unplaced die stores 1 charge, and each victory pays 5 scrap.
perksDesc.obsidianCreed: Black dice roll only min or max; charge cap +2; every battle starts with 1 charge per risk item you own.
perksDesc.lastBreath: Once per run, survive a lethal hit at 1 hull; a battle entered under a third hull starts with 8 shield.
perksDesc.singularity: Every die in the reactor stores 3 more charge and costs 1 hull, unless hull is under 40%.
perksDesc.widerGrip: Reroll one more die at a time.
perksDesc.toolRoll: One extra reroll every turn; max hull −2.
perksDesc.checklist: The first slot to resolve each turn banks 1 charge.
perksDesc.spareParts: A temporary grey d4 joins the tray for the first two turns of every battle.
perksDesc.routineCheck: Every node you enter goes into the log; from the tenth entry on, each battle opens with one extra reroll.
perksDesc.switchboard: Marks are worth +1 more damage, and when Sensors resolves your lowest die is rerolled.
perksDesc.gimbalMount: A die resolving in Engines or Sensors counts as at least 4.
perksDesc.logistics: Shops −12% with the first two rerolls free, but scrap income −8%.
perksDesc.quickHands: Reroll two more dice at a time, but you can no longer hold a die in reserve.
perksDesc.balanceBeam: Every die that rolls its top face gives up 1 to lift your lowest die by 2.
perksDesc.holdBack: Nudges cost 1 less charge, and with three items tagged «dice» you reserve one more die.
perksDesc.payloadShuffle: Reserve +2 dice, +1 more for a blue one, but the charge cap drops by 2.
perksDesc.shortHaul: +20% XP from the run; max hull −3.
perksDesc.dryDock: The Repair Bay heals 2 more hull for every item you carry tagged «repair bay», this one included.
perksDesc.masterKey: One extra reroll each turn and one more die per reroll; with three items tagged «reroll», one more of each again.
perksDesc.greyProtocol: With four grey dice, every battle opens with three free nudges and one more reserve slot.
perksDesc.spotterCall: 5 or more in sensors stores 1 charge.
perksDesc.hullWeld: The Repair Bay heals 1 more hull.
perksDesc.targetingSuite: Marks +2 damage, and resolving sensors stores 1 charge for each Precision item you carry.
perksDesc.shockLance: +5 in the Spinal Mount, and a die that lands there below 5 is rerolled as it drops in.
perksDesc.piercingRounds: The first hit each battle ignores shields, marks +1, and a max face in weapons deals 2 more damage for each Pierce item you carry.
perksDesc.snakeEyes: A weapon die on its min face still deals 3 damage.
perksDesc.looseBallast: One extra reroll every turn; hull −3.
perksDesc.downPayment: The first slot to resolve each turn gains +3 and costs 1 hull, unless hull is under 45%.
perksDesc.hazardPay: Entering a battle under half hull pays 10 scrap.
perksDesc.overdraft: Weapon slots accept dice above their cap for 2 hull each, and a weapon die of 9 or more banks 2 charge.
perksDesc.debtCollector: Every min face this battle is one entry in the ledger; from the fourth, each turn ends with 1 damage per risk item you own.
perksDesc.snowline: Every battle opens with 1 shield for each blue die in your deck.
perksDesc.rimeGuard: A die of another school placed into a slot never resolves below 2.
perksDesc.whiteNoise: End a turn with 4+ charge and the enemy's next attack is jammed.
perksDesc.iceSheet: While any Shieldwall item is aboard, every turn ends with 4 more shield.
perksDesc.bracingVanes: An engines die that is not on its max face reads +3.
perksDesc.nullField: Every turn ends with 2 shield per Shieldwall item, and with four of them the enemy's next attack is jammed.
perksDesc.takeRoot: Any die below 3 is raised to 3 the moment you commit it to a slot.
perksDesc.seedBank: Battle start: for the next three turns you raise 1 shield per growth item you carry.
perksDesc.understory: End of turn: if 4 or more shield is still standing, heal 1 hull.
perksDesc.mycelium: Once six slots have resolved this battle, every turn ends healing 2 hull and raising 3 shield.
perksDesc.rhizome: Engine thresholds two steps easier; hull −2.
perksDesc.taproot: Counts every node you enter; from the eighth on, each battle opens with 6 shield and 3 hull healed.
perksDesc.perennial: A die in engines that repeats last turn's value counts as four higher.
perksDesc.annualRings: Counts every die that repeats last turn's value; from the third on, every die counts as 3 higher for the rest of the battle.
perksDesc.dryRun: A die that repeats its previous value below 4 is rerolled.
perksDesc.teardown: Temporary dice are stripped down at the end of every turn, paying 1 scrap per item you carry tagged «dice».
perksDesc.tallySheet: Every die that resolves on its lowest face marks a tally, and every three tallies are cashed in for 3 charge at end of turn.
perksDesc.cargoHold: Reserve three more dice, but reroll one fewer at a time.
perksDesc.pointBlank: A max face in weapons hits for +3 and costs 1 hull.
perksDesc.ignition: The battle opens with Burn 2 on the enemy.
perksDesc.keelStrike: A max face in the Spinal Mount crits ×1.5.
perksDesc.runningHot: From the fourth weapon die of the battle on, weapon dice get +3.
perksDesc.ashfall: A max face in weapons deals 2 extra damage for each burn source you own.
perksDesc.stokehold: With three burn sources, every turn ends by adding Burn 2.
perksDesc.autoAlign: A die that lands in sensors below 3 is rerolled on the spot.
perksDesc.coreTap: Once the Reactor is Mk2, resolving it stores 2 more charge.

perksDesc.spallLiner: Every battle starts with 2 shield for each Survival item you carry.
perksDesc.crashPriority: Entering a battle above half hull burns 1 hull for 4 charge.
perksDesc.spareHands: Carry three Precision items and every battle starts with a free nudge.
perksDesc.overrideKeys: Enter a battle above 60% hull and any die fits a weapon slot over its cap for 2 hull.

perksDesc.refitCrew: Arriving at a node below half hull repairs 3.
perksDesc.fullRefit: +2 to every die once you carry four Precision items.
perksDesc.sureThing: A die placed at 1 or 2 on its lowest face becomes a 3 for 2 scrap.
perksDesc.chipStack: While you hold 5 or more charge, a max-face die in weapons lands a crit (×1.5 damage).
perksDesc.warChest: If you own even one [scrap] item, every battle opens with 3 charge.
perksDesc.marginCall: A die resolving below 4 in weapons buys +5 to its value for 3 scrap.
perksDesc.loadedDice: Fate can be rolled twice per battle, and a nudge costs 2 charge less.

driftingPod.text: A survivor pod tumbles across your bow, hull scarred, beacon stuttering. Something moves inside.

out.openAlly: A half-frozen scrapper spills out, grateful, and pays in salvage.
out.openAmbush: Not a survivor — a trap. Charges rake your hull before you seal the lock.
out.sell: A passing hauler takes it sealed, no questions. Coin changes hands.
out.leave: You let it drift on. Some doors are better left shut.

freedCourier.text: A courier drone hangs snared in a mag-net, running lights dimming. Its manifest is still encrypted.

out.free: You slice the net. The drone pings a quiet thanks and vanishes coreward.
out.ransom: You strip the manifest and sell the route. Business is business.
out.ignore: You leave it to the dark. The lights fade behind you.

courierReturns.text: A familiar drone matches your vector — the one you freed. It broadcasts a trader's handshake.

out.discount: It shares a smuggler's route. The next markets owe you a favour.
out.die: It jettisons a spare probability core into your hold.

cursedCargo.text: A sealed strongbox drifts alone, warded with cult glyphs. It is worth a fortune, and it is watching you back.

out.take: You haul it aboard. Somewhere in the dark, a tracking ping answers.
out.jettison: You send it spinning into the void. Whatever wanted it can chase the wreck.

bountyAmbush.text: A lean gunship drops out of the static, matching you exactly. "You're carrying marked cargo, captain. That makes you cargo too."

out.fight: No more talking. She commits — and so do you.
out.bribe: She counts the scrap twice, then peels away. "Nothing personal."

maraStall.text: A patched-together stall hangs off a dead freighter. "Mara," the trader says, not looking up. "You've got the look of someone who breaks things."

out.chat: You trade honest words. Rare currency out here. She almost smiles.
out.browse: You dig through the crates and pull something worth having.
out.robPass: You're gone before she reaches the alarm, pockets full and name burned.
out.robFail: She's faster than she looks. A shock-baton finds your hull as you flee.

maraFavor.text: Mara flags you down, warmer this time. "Word gets around. You dealt straight with me. Pick something — on the house."

out.repair: Her crew patches your hull with practised speed.
out.die: She presses a wrapped core into your hand. "Don't tell the others."

maraColdShoulder.text: Mara's channel opens cold. "The captain who robbed me. Word travels. My prices went up — for you especially."

out.apologize: You pay back double and then some. She grunts. It's a start.
out.walk: You cut the channel. Some bridges stay burned.

derelictReactor.text: A gutted hauler's reactor still ticks over, leaking charge into the dark. You could tap it, if the field holds.

out.siphonPass: The tap holds. Your cells drink deep — a head start on the fights ahead.
out.siphonFail: The field collapses mid-draw and bleeds into your hull.
out.salvage: You cut it apart the safe way and haul off the good plating.

mineFieldGap.text: A drifting minefield chokes the lane. There's a gap, if your piloting is exact — or a long way around.

out.threadPass: Clean run. You slip through the quiet corridor and lose the sector's attention for a while.
out.threadFail: A mine clips you on the way through. The hull remembers it.
out.around: You loop wide and scavenge the drifting wreckage along the edge.

choirBroadcast.text: A structured signal blooms across every band. A calm voice: "You have questions. The Core has already answered them. Only listen."

out.listen: The words settle into you like they were always there. Something shifts, quietly, toward resonance.
out.jam: You blanket the channel with noise. The sector bristles at the insult.

choirGift.text: The Choir's voice returns, gentle. "You listened once. Take this — a shard that remembers how to fall."

out.accept: A black core settles into your rack, cold and eager.
out.refuse: You decline. The voice does not argue. That's the unsettling part.

scrapAuction.text: Scavengers ring a floodlit wreck, bidding on sealed cores. The auctioneer eyes your scrap.

out.bid: Your bid holds. The core is yours — and it's a good one.
out.watch: You pocket a few loose parts nobody bid on.
out.bidHigh: Mara knocks it down to you and files your name under 'pays'.
out.bidLow: You take the second lot. Nobody else wanted it, which may be the point.
out.heckle: You talk the price down for somebody else and pocket their thanks. Mara does not thank you.

stowaway.text: You find a stowaway in the aft crawlspace — a mechanic who ran from something worse. "I earn my keep," she says.

out.keep: She reroutes power to a med-loop. Less hull, but she'll patch you after every fight.
out.handOver: You trade her to a passing patrol for coin. Neither of you meets the other's eye.

oldBeaconEcho.text: A fleet beacon still cycles, forty years on. Its keeper-AI stirs. "Report," it rasps. "Where is the fleet?"

out.decryptPass: The log cracks open — old charts spill across your sensors, revealing more of the lane.
out.decryptFail: The encryption holds. Only static, and a word repeated: quieter.
out.leave: You strip the beacon for parts and leave the ghost to its cycle.

leechNest.text: A cluster of leech skiffs feeds on a dead cruiser, cores half-drained. Burn them out, or slip past?

out.burn: You commit to the cull. The nest boils toward you.
out.avoid: You give the nest a wide berth and let the dead cruiser keep its parasites.

driftMerchant.text: A lone merchant hails you, hold full of odd cores. "Straight swap," he offers. "Your worst for a wildcard of mine."

out.swap: You trade your weakest core for one of his. Fair enough, out here.
out.decline: You wave him off. He shrugs and drifts on.

radiationPocket.text: A radiation pocket bars the direct lane. Push through and save time, or detour the safe way.

out.push: You gun it through the glare. It costs hull, but you shave the sector's grip.
out.detour: You take the long, clean route and scavenge as you go.

wardenCache.text: A Quarantine Warden supply cache sits sealed and armed. A recorded voice: "Unauthorised access will be answered."

out.crackPass: The lock yields. Inside: a Warden requisition chit — the next shipyard will honour it.
out.crackFail: The lock screams. Somewhere, a patrol logs your position.
out.leave: You leave the cache to its threats and move on.

alertedPatrol.text: A Warden patrol runs you down, flanked and ready. "Cache tamperer. Hold for inspection." They have no intention of inspecting.

out.engage: You commit to the breakout. They close in.
out.evadePass: You kill your lights and thread their sweep, lifting a few crates on the way out.
out.evadeFail: A picket clips you as you run. You lose the patrol, but not cleanly.

gamblersWreck.text: A ruined casino-barge still runs one game: a single die against the house AI. "Care to test your luck, captain?"

out.rollPass: The die lands your way. The house pays out with a resentful chime.
out.rollFail: The house wins, as houses do. Your stake vanishes.
out.scavenge: You skip the game and strip the derelict tables for parts.

frozenCrew.text: A lifeboat drifts with its crew in cold-sleep, power nearly gone. Thawing them costs fuel and scrap.

out.thaw: The pods hiss open. Grateful hands help patch your hull before they part ways.
out.leave: You can't spare the scrap. You mark their position and move on. Small mercy: they still drift.

crewGratitude.text: The crew you thawed catches up in a patched skiff. "We owe you. Let us tune your dice-racks."

out.crew: They rework your reroll gear. It'll spin one die wider, all run long.
out.pay: They press salvage on you instead, and wave you off toward the Core.

probCoreLeak.text: A probability core is cracking, bleeding raw uncertainty across your hold. It could be stabilised — or harvested.

out.stabilize: A blue core damps the leak. The board settles toward stability, and your hull steadies.
out.harvest: A black core drinks the chaos. Resonance surges, a fresh shard drops — and it costs a little hull.

silentField.text: A field of dead static, no signal, no wreckage. Just the hum of the Rim and your own breathing.

out.drift: Nothing answers. You scavenge loose plating on the way out.

tollGate.text: Scavengers have strung a wreck-gate across the lane and want a toll. Behind it, a single gunship waits.

out.pay: You hand over the scrap. The gate creaks open, grudgingly.
out.fight: You answer the toll with your weapons instead.
out.sneakPass: You drift dark past the gunship's arc and out the far side.
out.sneakFail: They spot you mid-slip. A parting shot finds your hull.

mirrorFlare.text: A mirror-flare blooms off a shattered array, throwing a copy of your own ship back at you — and a shard with it.

out.absorb: You pull a core from your own reflection. It hums with borrowed resonance.
out.lookAway: You shield your sensors and let the flare burn itself out.

driftRace.text: Yusuf's convoy runners idle at a marker buoy. "Fast hull like yours? Race us to the next beacon. Winner takes the pot."

out.race: Your engines eat the lane. You take the pot and their grudging respect.
out.decline: You let them have their fun and pocket a small stake for showing up.

sensorGhost.text: A sensor ghost flickers at the edge of your scope — maybe a wreck, maybe a trap. Sharper sensors could resolve it.

out.reveal: Your array pins it down and maps the lane beyond in the process.
out.fire: You loose a volley at the ghost. It scatters — and something scatters back.

yusufConvoy.text: Yusuf, convoy master, hails you plainly. "Raiders are shadowing my haulers. Escort us through and I'll make it worth your while. Or tax us and be gone."

out.escort: You take point. The raiders won't like it, but Yusuf will remember.
out.tax: You clip his margins and let him pass. He remembers that too.
out.escortHim: You take point. Yusuf's yard opens its books to you at the far end.
out.takeCargo: You cut the tether and run. Yusuf says nothing on the open channel. That's worse.

yusufEscortPaid.text: Yusuf's convoy finds you again, banners bright. "The captain who saw us through! Take a cut of the run — you earned it."

out.bonus: He loads scrap and a spare core into your hold, grinning the whole time.
out.wave: You wave off the pay. Yusuf salutes. Goodwill compounds out here.

beaconKeeperIntro.text: The beacon is older than the wreck field around it, and someone is still maintaining it. A figure in a patched suit waves you down without hurry. "You're the fifth salvager this decade. The other four took the key. None of them asked what it opens."
beaconKeeperIntro.take: Take the key and ask what it opens
beaconKeeperIntro.takeOut: "Nothing," the Keeper says. "It opens nothing. It proves you were here, and at the end that turns out to matter." The beacon's chart data floods your sensors.
beaconKeeperIntro.sell: Cut the beacon's core out and sell it
beaconKeeperIntro.sellOut: The Keeper does not stop you. They watch you strip forty years of maintenance into a cargo net, and they write something down.
beaconKeeperIntro.smash: Smash it — the signal is what draws them here
beaconKeeperIntro.smashOut: The beacon dies with a sound like a held breath. The interference in this sector drops immediately. So does the Keeper's expression.

fleetBlackbox.text: The blackbox is fused into a bulkhead that used to be a wall of a ship you have heard of. Yusuf's convoy is parked two hundred metres off, waiting to see what you do with it. "Whatever's on there," he says on open channel, "the clans have a right to know."
fleetBlackbox.shareOut: Yusuf listens to the whole thing without speaking, then puts his own mechanics on your hull for free. "Forty years," he says. "They were asking for help the entire time."
fleetBlackbox.keep: Keep it — the record is worth more intact
fleetBlackbox.keepOut: You seal the box in your hold. Yusuf's channel closes without a sign-off. Whatever is on it, it is yours alone now.
fleetBlackbox.wipe: Wipe it — nobody needs to hear this
fleetBlackbox.wipeOut: The recorder erases cleanly, the way things do when they were designed by people expecting to be found. The convoy stands down and patches your hull anyway.

choirInvitation.text: The Preacher's shuttle matches your drift without asking. "You have felt it," he says. "Every roll you take out here, every branch you leave open — it costs you. We can close them. All of them. It begins with one agreement."
choirInvitation.accept: Take the first step of the pact
choirInvitation.acceptOut: He marks your hull with a number. Your reactor runs hot and certain for a while, and something in the sector notices you differently.
choirInvitation.refuse: Refuse — out loud, on open channel
choirInvitation.refuseOut: The Preacher takes the refusal with a smile that suggests he expected it and has time. Your crew, hearing you say it, works harder.
choirInvitation.probe: Make him explain what the pact costs
choirInvitation.probePass: You keep him talking until the doctrine contradicts itself, then say so on the open channel. He leaves. The convoy that overheard pays you for the recording.
choirInvitation.probeFail: He answers every question patiently, and by the end you have agreed to something you cannot quite locate in the conversation.

pactSeal.text: The Choir's flagship holds the seal chamber open for you. The Preacher is already there, ledger out. "One signature and the Rim stops arguing with you. Or you walk, and it argues with you personally, for the rest of a short career."
pactSeal.complete: Sign — let them close the branches
pactSeal.completeOut: The ledger takes your name in a hand that is not yours. The Choir's fleet parts for you, and the Core's noise drops to a hum you can almost ignore.
pactSeal.betrayOut: You put a round through the ledger table and the chamber empties in eight seconds flat. The honour guard does not need instructions.

pactSealSkipped.text: The seal chamber is running a ceremony without you in it. Nobody stops you at the door; the Choir has decided you are furniture. Whatever they are closing, they are closing it now.
pactSealSkipped.watchOut: You take the whole liturgy on sensors and sell the recording twice before you reach the next lane. Understanding costs nothing here; certainty is what they charge for.
pactSealSkipped.burnOut: You put your engines through the chamber's field array. The hymn stops. Something in the sector starts paying you very close attention.

coreThreshold.text: The last beacon is not maintained, not broadcasting, and not, strictly speaking, present at all times. The Keeper is standing on it anyway. "Past here it stops asking," they say. "Whatever you brought with you is the argument you get to make."
coreThreshold.listen: Ask the Keeper what the fleet was asking for
coreThreshold.listenOut: They tell you. It takes four minutes and it is not what any report claimed. When they finish, they hand you the list of names and step back off the beacon.
coreThreshold.answer: Answer the Core's carrier on its own pattern
coreThreshold.answerOut: You broadcast into the Rift and something enormous adjusts its attention by a fraction of a degree. Your reactor has not been this eager since it was built.
coreThreshold.silenceOut: You shut every transmitter on the hull and drift past the threshold as a hole in the noise. It does not notice you. That is the point.

keeperEcho.text: A relay you have never used lights up with a name you recognise. The Keepers pass word along a chain of dead beacons, and yours has been passed. "The Rim is small," the voice says. "Smaller since you made it smaller."

opt.pay: Pay for what you cut out (40)
opt.shrug: They kept a beacon. You kept a career.

out.pay: The transfer clears and the chain of beacons stops talking about you. One of them even sends you its chart data, unasked.
out.shrug: The relay goes quiet mid-sentence. Two hours later the interference here is measurably worse, and nobody will explain why.

yusufLane.text: Yusuf's convoy is running a lane it has no business running this deep. He hails you first. "You gave us the box. Whole clans changed their route because of it. Name what you need."

opt.escort: Ask for hull work and a friendly dock
opt.trade: Ask for cargo and a cut

out.escort: His mechanics swarm the hull for six hours and refuse payment. One of them leaves a note on your reactor housing that just says THANK YOU.
out.trade: He pays out in scrap and one crate he claims fell off a Choir tender. You do not ask.

preacherGrudge.text: The Preacher's shuttle finds you again, deeper in and much less patient. "You said it in the open channel," he says. "Half the Rim heard. Say it again here, where it costs something. Or listen, once, properly."

out.repeat: You repeat it word for word. The Choir logs you as an enemy of the liturgy, and your crew reinforces the hull out of pure spite.
out.hear: You let him finish. It is beautiful and it is wrong, and something in your reactor keeps humming the shape of it for two jumps.

brokenBeaconWake.text: The sector is louder here than the charts allow, and the pattern of the noise is a beacon-shaped hole. A Keeper is already parked in it, working with parts they do not have enough of.

out.rebuild: They get it lit before you leave. The interference drops across the whole sector and the Keeper does not thank you, which is how you know it counted.
out.scavenge: You leave with a full net and a Keeper watching you go. The hole in the noise stays exactly where it was.

driftSalvageCrew.text: A breaker crew is riding a hull that has eleven hours of air and no engine. Yusuf's lane is four jumps away. Their captain does not beg; she just reads out the number of people aboard, twice.

opt.rescue: Take them aboard — all of them
opt.tow: Rig a tow and burn for the lane

out.rescue: Eleven people, one head of lettuce, and a hold you can no longer walk through. They fix things constantly, whether or not you asked.
out.towPass: The tow holds. Yusuf's people meet you halfway and pay salvage rates for a rescue, which is not how salvage works.
out.towFail: The line snaps under load and takes a chunk of your hull with it. You get them home. Nobody is grateful for how.
out.strip: You take the reactor coupling and the good plating. The channel stays open behind you for a long time.

riftMirror.text: A sheet of collapsed probability hangs across the lane, and your ship is on the other side of it, doing something you have not done yet. It is waiting to see whether you do.

out.matchPass: You do the thing before you see yourself do it, and the sheet folds inward with a sound like a card being turned over. What falls out is yours.
out.matchFail: You hesitate. The mirror does not, and what comes through the sheet is very interested in you.
out.break: The sheet shatters into ordinary debris worth ordinary money. Whatever it was going to show you, it does not.

coreStatic.text: This deep, the Core's carrier is not a signal any more, it's weather. Every instrument on the ship has an opinion about it and none of them agree.

opt.shield: Shield the hull and ride it out
opt.ride: Feed it straight into the reactor

out.tune: You get three rows of the sector for free and a headache that lasts a jump. Echo asks you, twice, to stop.
out.shield: You spend an hour wrapping the hull in its own noise. Nothing happens, which is the entire point of doing it.
out.ride: The reactor drinks it. Everything runs hot and eager for a while and the hull pays the difference.

scavRefit.text: Mara's tender is parked in a lane it should not be in, with the awning out. "Don't look at me like that. Deep sector, deep margins. What do you need, captain?"

out.buy: She bolts a scavenged sorting rig into your tray. It rattles. It also works.
out.swap: She takes your worst die without comment and hands back something with a different kind of wrong in it.
out.pass: She buys the lot at a fair price, which from Mara is practically a compliment.

clanToll.text: A clan skiff cuts across the lane and holds station. «Toll's thirty. The lane's ours this cycle.»

out.pay: They wave you through and mark your hull as paid. The lane opens two rows deeper.
out.runPass: You thread past before they close. Somebody's cargo comes loose in the wake.
out.runFail: They clip your flank on the way out. The clan remembers faces.

magnetGraveyard.text: A tug boneyard, hulls locked together by their own magnets. Forty years of nobody letting go.

out.strip: Good haul. The clamps take a bite out of your plating on the way out.
out.salvageCore: One core still holds a charge. It comes free clean.
out.leave: You cut power and drift past. The field quiets behind you.

yusufDebt.text: Yusuf's voice, flat and tired: «You owe my lane a hull. Sixty, or we settle the other way.»

out.settle: He counts it twice and puts the ledger away. «Then we're square, captain.»
out.refuse: The lane closes behind you and two of his tugs come about.

minefieldLane.text: An inherited minefield, laid by nobody currently alive. There's a thread through it, if you trust the plot.

out.threadPass: Clean run. From the far side you can see three rows of lane.
out.threadFail: A drifter clips the belly. The hull rings for a long time.
out.detonate: You blow a corridor open. The noise brings company.

crewReunion.text: The crew you pulled off the wreck flag you down. They've been waiting on this lane for a while.

out.hire: Four extra hands. The tray gets tidier and the hull gets patched.
out.sendOff: They leave with their share and a lane's worth of goodwill.

hunterTrail.text: A narrow-band hail, unencrypted. The Huntress reads your registry back to you, digit by digit.

out.buyOff: She takes the scrap and closes the channel. The trail goes quiet, for now.
out.ambushHer: You cut the reply short and come about. She sounds almost pleased.

driftChapel.text: A chapel welded into a hauler's hold. The Preacher keeps the door open and the arithmetic running.

out.listen: The numbers make an unpleasant kind of sense. You leave carrying current.
out.refuse: You leave mid-verse. The hull feels solider for the refusal.

tetheredHulk.text: A liner hulk on a single tether, swinging slow. Somebody moored it deliberately.

out.boardIt: The interior is intact and airless. You come back with something worth the bruises.
out.cutFree: You take the mooring gear and let the hulk drift. Good cable is good cable.

beaconRelay.text: A relay mast, half its array sheared off. It still tries to speak on the hour.

out.repairIt: It comes back up mid-sentence. The Keeper's network notes who fixed it.
out.stripIt: Good parts. The mast goes dark behind you and stays dark.

fuelBloom.text: A slow bloom of unspent drive fuel, hanging in the lane like weather.

out.siphon: The reactor drinks it happily. Several battles' worth of head start.
out.burnIt: The bloom goes up and takes the interference with it. And some paint.

foldedHour.text: The clock on the bridge runs twice and then stops apologising. The Rift is folding an hour around you.

out.waitOut: You sit inside the fold and let the crew sleep. Something outside gets closer while you do.
out.pushPass: You come out the far side with four rows of clean plot and a headache.
out.pushFail: You come out sideways. Something structural did not come out at all.

mirrorSelf.text: A hull identical to yours holds station off the bow. Its running lights answer half a second before you signal.

out.speak: It answers in your own voice, and it is kinder than you are. You leave carrying something it gave you.
out.shoot: It breaks apart without resistance. Your own hull takes the damage anyway.

clanEscort.text: A clan wing forms up on your flank, unasked. «You paid. This is what paid buys.»

out.acceptEscort: They fly cover for three jumps and hand you a full reactor at the parting.
out.takeMap: They dump four rows of lane plot and a bag of scrap. «Cheaper than flying with you.»

clanReprisal.text: Three clan hulls, no hail. They've been waiting on this row since the lane.

out.standGround: You hold the line. The Rim respects that, which is not the same as surviving it.
out.payLate: They take the scrap and the insult together. The lane reopens.

riftHarvest.text: A vein of Rift shards, growing out of nothing, cut clean by something that isn't there.

out.cutShards: It comes away as a prismatic chip. The recoil takes a bite out of the hull.
out.mapVein: You sell the survey ahead and read two rows of lane off the same data.

relayEcho.text: The relay you fixed is talking. Not repeating — talking.

out.answerIt: The Keeper's network opens a channel to you. Something in the sector eases.
out.sellIt: Somebody pays well for a Keeper frequency. The Keeper finds out. He always finds out.

choirProbe.text: The Preacher, on your private band: «You listened once. Listening twice is a choice.»

out.kneel: The pact opens. So does a case of cores you were not offered before.
out.walkAway: You close the band mid-verse. The refusal is on record now.

hunterRespect.text: The Huntress hails you openly this time. «You cost me a wing. Say what you want.»

out.hireHer: She flies your flank for the rest of the sector and never once explains her ledger.
out.warnHer: She listens. Then she gives you something from her own hold and cuts the channel.

anomalyLedger.text: A ward tablet, floating in clean vacuum. Somebody wrote the arithmetic out longhand and left it here.

out.solvePass: The arithmetic closes. Whatever the ward was holding shut hands you a core.
out.solveFail: You get the sign wrong. The ward opens the wrong way, and the sector notices.
out.burnLedger: You unmake the question. The Rift quiets, and something out here approves.

twinWreck.text: Two identical wrecks, same registry, same damage. The Rift is fond of this joke.

out.leftHull: Intact hold, one good core still in its cradle.
out.leftEmpty: Stripped to the frame — by you, apparently, in some other reading of this hour.
out.rightHull: A full pay chest, untouched. Nobody claimed it because nobody found it twice.
out.rightTrap: The hold is bait. Something was waiting to be boarded.

warpedShipyard.text: A yard that finished building itself after the crew left. The tools still run.

out.refit: The frame comes back heavier than it went in. You choose not to ask.
out.swapPart: It takes your worst core and hands back something else. Fair, by its own arithmetic.

quietStar.text: A star with no output and a real gravity well. The instruments hate it; the crew likes the quiet.

out.chartIt: With sensors this good you plot four rows off the well alone.
out.restThere: Real sleep, first in days. The sector uses the time too.

hymnGate.text: A gate of hulls, all tuned to one chord. They will open for a voice, or for silence.

out.singAlong: Your reactor picks up the chord and keeps it. The gate opens gladly.
out.jamIt: You put a wall of noise across their band. The gate opens because it has to.

pactSealing.text: The Preacher lays the pact out twice: one copy for you, one for the Core.

out.signIt: The ink is a probability. Something in the hull agrees to be less certain from now on.
out.tearIt: You tear both copies. The Choir stops calling you a guest.

heretics.text: A handful of hulls with the hymn scraped off their plating. They heard you refused too.

out.armThem: You hand over cores and cutting gear. They fly out singing nothing at all.
out.reportThem: The Choir pays for the coordinates. You do not stay to watch.

keeperVault.text: The Keeper opens a hatch he has kept welded for thirty years. «You've earned the choice, not the contents.»

out.openVault: Fleet-issue, sealed since the silence. It answers to your hand immediately.
out.leaveSealed: You weld it shut yourself. The Keeper says nothing, and gives you the plating.

mirrorReturn.text: The mirror hull is back, and this time it is waiting where you were going.

out.listenAgain: It tells you the route. All of it. You do not ask how it knows.
out.sealIt: You close the fold with everything you have. The hull pays for it.

huntressFavor.text: «One favour,» the Huntress says. «Spend it here or carry it. Your ledger.»

out.callFavor: She drops a crate on your dorsal clamp and is gone before you thank her.
out.saveFavor: She routes you a private supply channel instead. It keeps paying.

reliquaryRun.text: A reliquary hull, escorted by one cantor. Whatever's inside has not been opened in decades.

out.raidIt: You commit. The cantor stops singing and starts firing.
out.trade: They accept a yellow core as tribute and swap you something stranger.

choirTithe.text: A tithe station. The Choir accepts scrap, hull, or nothing — and prices all three honestly.

out.tithe: They reinforce your frame with something that was a hymn an hour ago.
out.bleed: They cut a plate off you and hand back a core. The trade is exact.
out.declineTithe: You pass the plate along. The station's tone changes for the rest of the sector.

organShip.text: A ship built around an organ, still tuned, still playing to nobody.

out.tunePass: You find the chord. Something in your dice tray learns it too.
out.tuneFail: You find the wrong chord. The hull finds out first.
out.silenceOrgan: You cut the bellows. The sector gets quieter and slightly cheaper.

acolyteDefector.text: An acolyte in a stolen skiff, running on fumes and a number instead of a name.

out.shelter: She earns her passage inside an hour, and reads Choir routing like a map.
out.handOver: The Choir pays promptly. Nobody on your bridge speaks for a while.

voiceInTheHull.text: Something is using your own intercom. It is polite, and it knows your rank.

out.answerVoice: It gives you a great deal of current and asks for nothing yet.
out.purgeVoice: You burn the intercom out at the root. It hurts. It works.

hymnArchive.text: An archive hull, wall to wall with hymn plates. The oldest one is a ship manifest.

out.copyIt: You take a full record. Echo reads it for the rest of the sector.
out.burnArchive: Forty years of arithmetic, gone in nine minutes. The Choir will hear about it.

causalityTide.text: A tide of loose causality, running the wrong way down the lane.

out.rideTide: You arrive five rows further along than you should. The hull disagrees about how.
out.anchorHere: You hold position until it passes. The crew gets an hour that counts.

coreBargain.text: The pact you signed comes due. The Core would like to make it permanent.

out.acceptBargain: Something in the deck becomes certain in the wrong direction. It is extremely powerful.
out.renege: You tear it out at the root. The hull nearly goes with it.

hereticFleet.text: The heretics you armed have made a fleet of it, and they are asking who leads.

out.leadThem: Nine hulls fall in behind you, singing nothing, very loudly.
out.sendThemHome: They leave you their stores and their gratitude. Both are heavy.

silentSignal.text: The Keeper's channel opens one last time. «If you're going to call the fleet, call it from here.»

out.broadcast: Forty years of silence, and something answers on the old frequency.
out.keepSilent: You keep the fleet out of it. The Keeper gives you what he was saving for them.

defectorReturns.text: The acolyte you sheltered is waiting at the last waypoint, with a route and a request.

out.takeHerAboard: She runs your tray like she was born to it. Nothing in the Choir surprises her.
out.sendHerBack: She leaves you everything she carried. It is more than you expected.

brokenLighthouse.text: A lighthouse nobody built, dark for the first time in forty years.

out.relight: It catches. From here you can see the whole approach to the Core.
out.harvestLens: The lens is a prismatic core the size of a fist. The dark stays dark.

unwrittenTurn.text: A stretch of lane where nothing has happened yet. It is waiting for a first draft.

out.writePass: You commit an outcome and it holds. Something extraordinary is left in the hold.
out.writeFail: You commit an outcome and it does not hold. Neither does the hull.
out.leaveBlank: You pass through without deciding anything. The ship feels solider for it.

coreChoirWreck.text: A Choir flagship, intact and stopped. Every name is still on the hull.

out.salvageIt: The hold is full. So is the escort you didn't see on approach.
out.readNames: You read all of them aloud. It takes an hour, and it is worth the hour.

lastMarket.text: Mara has set up on a dead hull at the edge of the Core. «Last stock in the sector, captain.»

out.buyOut: She hands over the good crate without haggling, which is how you know it's the end.
out.sellShip: She pays honestly for the armour. You will feel this later.
out.walkPast: «Suit yourself.» She still slips you a repair kit on the way out.

maraLedger.text: Mara opens her ledger to your page. «Credit or a tip. I'm not doing both.»

out.takeCredit: Scrap up front, debt on the page. She underlines your name twice.
out.takeTip: Three rows of route and a core she wasn't supposed to have.

maraCollector.text: Not Mara — her collector. He has the page with your name and no interest in conversation.

out.settleDebt: He tears the page out and hands it to you. «She says you're welcome back.»
out.outrun: You lose him in the lane. He was never the expensive part.

hymnResidue.text: The chord you sang is still in the reactor housing. It has not stopped.

out.keepHumming: It feeds the reactor and asks nothing. That is the concerning part.
out.scourIt: You cut it out plate by plate. The silence afterwards is yours again.

jammedChoir.text: The choir you jammed is still off-key, and one of their cantors is stranded in the lane.

out.pressAdvantage: You take the wreck apart while it is still finding the note.
out.slipAway: You use their confusion as cover. Two rows of lane, no shots fired.

clanFerry.text: A clan ferry, running the deep lanes on schedule. Your hull is marked as paid.

out.rideAlong: Four rows in convoy, and their medic looks at your hull for free.
out.buyLane: They sign the lane over and throw in a yard discount to close it.

darkRelay.text: A Keeper relay, running on the emergency band. It has been calling your registry for two sectors.

out.confess: You tell him what you took. He is quiet for a long time, and then forgives it.
out.jamHim: You cut him off and sell the relay's position. It pays well and sits badly.

emptySuit.text: A suit drifting alone, arms folded, tether cut from the inside.

out.readLog: Coordinates, a name, and a route somebody wanted found.
out.stripSuit: Good seals, good scrap. You leave the name plate where it is.

coldEngine.text: A drive assembly, cold for decades, still bolted into half a hull.

out.warmIt: It turns over. You take the working parts and leave it running.
out.gutIt: One good core in the housing. The frame fights you for it.

probabilityRain.text: Loose probability, falling through the lane like rain. Some of it lands.

out.standGood: Something condenses in the tray. It is beautiful and it works.
out.standBad: Something condenses in the hull. It is neither.
out.shelter: You wait it out under a wreck and come out with a charged reactor.

salvageCourt.text: Two crews, one wreck, and a very old argument about who arrived first.

out.arbitrate: You split it down the middle. Both sides pay you the arbiter's cut.
out.takeBoth: You take the lot and leave two crews with a shared grievance.

convoyRun.text: Yusuf's convoy is short an escort and long on cargo. «One lane. You keep station, I keep the books open.»

out.escortHim: You take point. Yusuf's yard opens its books to you at the far end.
out.takeCargo: You cut the tether and run. Yusuf says nothing on the open channel. That's worse.

driftAuction.text: Mara's auction, run off a barge ramp. Two lots, one crowd, no receipts.

out.bidHigh: Mara knocks it down to you and files your name under 'pays'.
out.bidLow: You take the second lot. Nobody else wanted it, which may be the point.
out.heckle: You talk the price down for somebody else and pocket their thanks. Mara does not thank you.

silentField.title: The Silent Fields
silentField.body: Pockets of the Rim where every signal dies at the edge. The expedition logged them as safe. Nothing that entered one was ever heard from again — not because it was destroyed, but because it stopped being certain.

oldBeacon.title: Fleet Beacon 7
oldBeacon.body: A relay from the lost expedition, still cycling a forty-year-old handshake into the dark. Its last clear transmission was a single word, repeated: quieter, quieter, quieter.

choirSignal.title: The Choir
choirSignal.body: A structured broadcast that seems to answer questions you have not asked aloud. The cult that formed around it believes the Core is listening. They may be right, which is the frightening part.

driftGraves.title: The Drift Graves
driftGraves.body: Scavenger clans mark their dead by cutting them loose to drift coreward. Over forty years the current has gathered them into a slow, glittering reef of hulls that never quite arrives.

riddleWard.title: Warded Anomalies
riddleWard.body: Some anomalies resolve like locks: feed them the exact outcome and they open. The expedition's engineers called it 'arguing with the dice.' It works, until the dice argue back.

keeperCreed.title: The Keeper's Creed
keeperCreed.body: Beacon Keepers do not repair the beacons. They witness them. Each one carries a key that opens nothing, and a list of names that opens everything.

fleetBlackbox.title: The Fleet's Black Box
fleetBlackbox.body: Eleven ships, one recorder, and a final entry that is not a log at all but a request — repeated, patiently, for thirty-nine years.

choirDoctrine.title: Choir Doctrine
choirDoctrine.body: The Choir holds that uncertainty is suffering and that a collapsed outcome is a mercy. They are consistent about this, which is the frightening part.

pactLedger.title: The Pact Ledger
pactLedger.body: Every pact is written twice: once in the ledger, once in the signer. The Choir has never had to enforce one.

coreThreshold.title: The Threshold
coreThreshold.body: Past the last beacon the sector stops having a shape. Instruments still work; they simply stop agreeing about when they worked.

memory-1.title: Fragment 1 — Boot
memory-1.body: First thing I remember is a countdown. Not to launch. To something the expedition called 'the ask'.

memory-2.title: Fragment 2 — Muster
memory-2.body: Eleven ships. I was the small one — sensor sweeps and bad ideas.

memory-3.title: Fragment 3 — The Rim
memory-3.body: We crossed the Rim on a Tuesday. Command logged it as uneventful. Command logged a lot of things as uneventful.

memory-4.title: Fragment 4 — First Core
memory-4.body: We found the first probability core inside a rock. It was not in the rock. The rock was in it.

memory-5.title: Fragment 5 — The Ask
memory-5.body: You do not ask a core a question. You ask it to stop being able to answer differently.

memory-6.title: Fragment 6 — Drift
memory-6.body: Two ships went into the Drift Fields for anchor mass and came back a year older in eight days.

memory-7.title: Fragment 7 — Split
memory-7.body: Half the fleet wanted to seal it. Half wanted to listen. Nobody wanted to leave.

memory-8.title: Fragment 8 — The Choir
memory-8.body: The listeners started calling themselves something. That is always the moment it goes wrong.

memory-9.title: Fragment 9 — Last Signal
memory-9.body: I was ordered to broadcast a pattern until someone came. I have been very obedient.

memory-10.title: Fragment 10 — The Cut
memory-10.body: When the Core took them it did not take them apart. It took them aside.

memory-11.title: Fragment 11 — Me
memory-11.body: I was the piece that fell off. Forty years of drifting, and the pattern was still running.

memory-12-seal.title: Fragment 12 — Closed
memory-12-seal.body: It's over, I remember all of it, and none of it is happening any more. I'll take that trade.

memory-12-merge.title: Fragment 12 — Opened
memory-12-merge.body: You're in here with them now. I can hear you thinking in the pattern. It suits you.

memory-12-bargain.title: Fragment 12 — Signed
memory-12-bargain.body: They filed my crew under 'pending'. I am told that is not the same as lost.

memory-12-silent.title: Fragment 12 — Answered
memory-12-silent.body: Eleven ships. I remember every name. For the first time in forty years, so does someone else.

oreVein.title: Ore Vein
oreVein.goal: Deal exactly {{n}} — the vein shears if you over-cut. Leave a die out.

coolant.title: Coolant Line
coolant.goal: Bank exactly {{n}} charge — the core drinks in steps of one and a half.

cleanFit.title: Clean Fit
cleanFit.goal: Bank {{n}}+ charge with every die placed and nothing spilled past the cap.

redRoute.title: Red Route
redRoute.goal: Deal {{n}}+ damage — a red die in Weapon A, affinity firing.

ignite.title: Ignite
ignite.goal: Deal {{n}}+ damage and land Burn — a cinder must hit its max face.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.goal: Mark, then land {{n}}+ into the marked target, and do not overflow the reactor.

overload.title: Overload
overload.goal: Jam the spinal on purpose, then carry {{n}}+ damage on the mounts.

slowBurn.title: Slow Burn
slowBurn.goal: Two turns: set Burn, reserve a hitter, and stack {{n}}+ total damage.

capacitor.title: Capacitor
capacitor.goal: Bank {{n}}+ charge across three turns — one core cannot hold it all at once.

lockbox.title: Lockbox
lockbox.goal: Fixed reading — one routing lands damage, shield and {{n}}+ charge at once.

parity.title: Parity Lock
parity.goal: Fixed reading — {{n}}+ damage, Weapons odd, Shields even. Mind the faces.

bulwarkStand.title: Bulwark Stand
bulwarkStand.goal: Survive the barrage and still hold {{n}}+ shield — layer the defence.

mirrorMath.title: The Mirror
mirrorMath.goal: Deal {{n}} or more using at most two slots.

engraverBench.title: The Bench
engraverBench.goal: Raise {{n}} shield with at least two slots filled.

blackVault.title: The Vault
blackVault.goal: Store {{n}} charge using a school's own system.

spinalDrill.title: Spinal Drill
spinalDrill.goal: Mark, jam the Spinal, then deal {{n}}.

coolChain.title: Cool Chain
coolChain.goal: Shields first, then {{n}} charge, and no overflow.

shieldWall.title: Shield Wall
shieldWall.goal: End the second turn on {{n}} shield.

fateBench.title: Fixed Odds
fateBench.goal: One roll, one placement: damage, shield, and {{n}} charge.

sortingYard.title: Sorting Yard
sortingYard.goal: Deal {{n}} or more with an even total in Weapon A.

choirStand.title: The Choir Stand
choirStand.goal: Survive the charged volley on {{n}} shield or more.

emberCut.title: Ember Cut
emberCut.goal: Land within two of {{n}} damage — the seam gives at either edge.

driftSpark.title: Drift Spark
driftSpark.goal: Bank {{n}} charge, give or take two. The coil is forgiving; the core is not.

plateFit.title: Plate Fit
plateFit.goal: Raise exactly {{n}} shield. The plate seats or it does not.

hairline.title: Hairline
hairline.goal: One mount, exactly {{n}} damage. Everything else stays in the tray.

tithe.title: The Tithe
tithe.goal: Exactly {{n}} charge, and the reactor takes its cut first.

deadWeight.title: Dead Weight
deadWeight.goal: Deal {{n}}+ with every die placed — the ballast has to go somewhere.

blueLane.title: Blue Lane
blueLane.goal: Raise {{n}}+ shield with a blue die in the Shields — the lane is keyed.

spread.title: The Spread
spread.goal: Deal {{n}}+ across three systems. Nothing concentrated survives the scan.

greenhouse.title: Greenhouse
greenhouse.goal: Deal {{n}}+ and make something grow — a green die must land on its top face.

overcut.title: Overcut
overcut.goal: Bank {{n}}+ charge and force a die past a cap it does not fit.

tightPack.title: Tight Pack
tightPack.goal: Bank {{n}}+ charge across two systems with nothing spilled past a cap.

oddPlate.title: Odd Plate
oddPlate.goal: Raise {{n}}+ shield reading odd, with the engines reading even.

redOnly.title: Red Only
redOnly.goal: Deal {{n}}+ with a red die in Weapon A, and Burn has to land.

perfectSeal.title: Perfect Seal
perfectSeal.goal: One reading only: {{n}}+ damage, every die placed, Weapons odd, Shields and the core even.

firstLight.title: First Light
firstLight.goal: Mark first, then put {{n}}+ into what the sensors found.

coldStart.title: Cold Start
coldStart.goal: Shields up first, then {{n}}+ charge into a cold core.

braceGate.title: Brace Gate
braceGate.goal: Mark, brace for {{n}}+ shield, and leave the reactor unflooded.

siegeLine.title: Siege Line
siegeLine.goal: Jam the spinal on purpose, carry {{n}}+ on the mounts, and hold the core.

markedBurn.title: Marked Burn
markedBurn.goal: Mark, jam the spinal, and still land {{n}}+ on the mount.

dryDock.title: Dry Dock
dryDock.goal: Shields, then {{n}}+ charge, and not one point over the cap.

theWholeChain.title: The Whole Chain
theWholeChain.goal: Mark, bank without flooding, and finish on {{n}}+ — one pass, no rerolls.

ironBank.title: Iron Bank
ironBank.goal: Three turns, one core: bank {{n}}+ without ever spilling.

twinFuse.title: Twin Fuse
twinFuse.goal: The first die sits out turn one. Still reach {{n}}+ across the two.

longWall.title: Long Wall
longWall.goal: Only the last turn counts. End on {{n}}+ shield — hold a die back for it.

slowFuse.title: Slow Fuse
slowFuse.goal: The first die sits out turn one. Burn and mounts must still total {{n}}+.

reactorRun.title: Reactor Run
reactorRun.goal: The first die sits out turn one, and there are no rerolls. Bank {{n}}+.

theLongCount.title: The Long Count
theLongCount.goal: Three turns, no rerolls, the first die held back — and {{n}}+ banked at the end.

ledger.title: The Ledger
ledger.goal: Fixed reading — every die booked, Shields reading even, {{n}}+ damage on the line.

crossWire.title: Cross-Wire
crossWire.goal: Fixed reading — damage, shield and {{n}}+ charge out of one routing.

mirrorRead.title: Mirror Read
mirrorRead.goal: Fixed reading — {{n}}+ damage with Burn landed. Only one way round.

theSeal.title: The Seal
theSeal.goal: Fixed reading — {{n}}+ damage, Shields reading even, nothing spilled past a cap.

hullCheck.title: Hull Check
hullCheck.goal: Take the volley and still stand on {{n}}+ shield.

lastLight.title: Last Light
lastLight.goal: Survive the volley with {{n}}+ charge still in the core.

stormFront.title: Storm Front
stormFront.goal: Survive the volley and answer it with {{n}}+ damage in the same turn.

theVigil.title: The Vigil
theVigil.goal: One reading, no board changes: take the heaviest volley in the sector and still hold {{n}}+ charge.

levelUp.1: A new rank. The record notices you now, captain.
levelUp.2: Level up. The Star Chart just widened — go spend it.
levelUp.3: You grew. So did the map of what we could become.
levelUp.4: Captain's rating up. Somebody's keeping score after all.
levelUp.5: Promotion. No ceremony out here, sorry.
levelUp.6: Another rank. Another point on the chart.

resume.1: Welcome back, captain. I recalculated the odds. Still against us.
resume.2: You're back. The dark didn't miss you. I did, a little.
resume.3: Systems warm. You were gone longer than the log admits, captain.
resume.4: Welcome back. I kept the lights on and the numbers honest.
resume.5: Still here. Still counting. Ready when you are.
resume.6: I ran the diagnostics twice. Boredom is a state, apparently.
resume.7: Course held. Nothing found us while you were away.
resume.8: Good. I was starting to compose an obituary.
resume.9: Everything where you left it. Sadly, including the damage.
resume.10: Back at the board, captain. The sector didn't move.

sectorEnter1.1: The Hush Rim. The name is honest.
sectorEnter1.2: Forty years of silence, and we brought the noise.
sectorEnter1.3: The Rim. Where the fleet stopped answering.

lowHull.1: The hull is complaining. So am I, just quieter.
lowHull.2: We're taking this personally now. The hull, I mean.
lowHull.3: 'Structural integrity' is a generous term for what we have.
lowHull.4: Hull's thin, captain. Thinner than my patience.
lowHull.5: I can hear the frame. That's not a sound it should make.
lowHull.6: One more like that and we're a fragment for somebody else.
lowHull.9: We're past careful and into lucky, captain.
lowHull.10: I'm not panicking. I'm reporting at volume.

battleWin.3: Logged as a win. Barely counts, but logged.
battleWin.4: Clean. I'll note it as intentional.
battleWin.5: Field's clear. So is my conscience, mostly.
battleWin.6: That went better than the arithmetic suggested.
battleWin.8: Good rolls. Good placement. Mostly good placement.
battleWin.9: Logged as a win. I'm generous with definitions.
battleWin.11: You made that look deliberate, captain.
battleWin.12: Salvage rights are ours by the only law out here.

nearDeathWin.1: Filing that under: do not repeat.
nearDeathWin.2: We lived. I'll pretend that was the plan.
nearDeathWin.3: We are alive on a technicality. I'll take it.
nearDeathWin.4: That was not a plan. That was a coincidence with good timing.
nearDeathWin.5: Hull integrity: theoretical. Morale: also theoretical.
nearDeathWin.6: Please don't do that again. Please do it again if it works.

tideUp.1: Interference is rising. The sector noticed us.
tideUp.2: The static is climbing. It knows we're here.
tideUp.3: Interference is climbing. Everything hits harder from here.
tideUp.4: The sector just tightened its grip, captain.
tideUp.5: Tide up. The numbers stop being friendly now.
tideUp.6: Noise floor rising. So is everything else.

rareLoot.1: Careful with that one. It… thinks.
rareLoot.2: That core is humming. Cores shouldn't hum.
rareLoot.3: That's a good one. Don't sell it out of habit.
rareLoot.4: Rare core. Somebody died for that, statistically.
rareLoot.5: Oh, that's lovely. Put it in the deck, captain.
rareLoot.6: Fleet-grade. Forty years and it still holds a face.
rareLoot.7: I'd call that a find. I rarely call anything a find.
rareLoot.9: That one changes a build. Choose deliberately.
rareLoot.10: Worth the hull we spent. Nearly.
rareLoot.11: Handle it gently. It's older than the wreck it was in.
rareLoot.12: New core. New habits, if you're willing.

eventNeg.2: I'd say I told you so. But I didn't. This time.
eventNeg.4: That cost us. I'm noting who chose it.
eventNeg.5: Consequences arrive on schedule out here.
eventNeg.6: Well. That's a decision we live with now.
eventNeg.8: I'd argue, but the ledger already has.
eventNeg.10: The sector took its cut, captain.

eventPos.1: That went better than the math promised.
eventPos.2: Take the win, captain. They're rare out here.
eventPos.3: That went our way. Rare. Enjoy it.
eventPos.4: Good call. I'll pretend I suggested it.
eventPos.5: Profit and no holes. A fine afternoon.
eventPos.6: I like this outcome. I like very few outcomes.
eventPos.7: Somebody out here still keeps their word.
eventPos.9: That's the sort of choice that gets remembered kindly.
eventPos.10: Noted, logged, and quietly approved of.

idleMap.1: The map won't decide for us, captain.
idleMap.2: Whenever you're ready. The dark can wait.
idleMap.3: Take your time. The sector is patient and so am I.
idleMap.4: Every route from here is a different kind of expensive.
idleMap.5: Fog's thick ahead. Sensors would help with that.
idleMap.6: I've charted worse. Not recently, but I have.

setComplete.1: Resonance caught. Don't ask how it works.
setComplete.2: The cores are singing together. That's usually a warning.
setComplete.3: Set locked. The deck just started agreeing with itself.
setComplete.4: Resonance holding. You'll feel that next roll.
setComplete.5: Four of a school. The cores like company.
setComplete.6: That's a proper build now, captain.
setComplete.7: The whole tray hums. That's the good hum.

killJammer.1: The jammer's quiet. I can finally hear myself think.
killJammer.2: No more static from that one. Small mercies.

killLeech.1: It let go. I hate when things touch the dice.
killLeech.2: Detached. My cores are mine again.

killRaider.1: One raider fewer. The Rim keeps score.
killRaider.2: That one won't be salvaging us today.

killChoir.1: The hymn stopped. I don't miss it.
killChoir.2: One less voice in the choir. Good.

killWasp.1: The wasp's gone. Watch your weapon mount anyway.
killWasp.2: Swatted. The rift breeds more, though.

killWarden.1: Its shields are somebody else's problem now.
killWarden.2: Warden down. The wall comes with us.

killScav.1: Drone's slag. It wanted our dice too.
killScav.2: One less drone picking at the wreck.

memory.1: Something just came back. Give me a second, captain.
memory.2: That's another piece of me. Filed under 'unpleasant, useful'.
memory.3: I remember more of them now. That's not entirely a gift.
memory.4: Another piece of me came back. I'm not sure I wanted this one.

sectorEnter2.1: Drift Fields. Everything here is somebody's salvage, including us.
sectorEnter2.2: Watch the mines. They've had forty years to get bored.
sectorEnter2.3: Drift Fields. Mind the lanes and mind the clans.

sectorEnter3.1: The Rift. My sensors are voting and they disagree.
sectorEnter3.2: Don't trust the readings. Don't trust the dice either, honestly.
sectorEnter3.3: The Rift. Trust the resolver, not the instruments.

sectorEnter4.1: Choir space. They'll be polite. That's the worrying part.
sectorEnter4.2: If they start singing numbers at you, captain, do not sing back.
sectorEnter4.3: The Choir. They'll be polite. That's the unsettling part.

sectorEnter5.1: The Core. I have been pointed at this place for forty years.
sectorEnter5.2: Whatever happens here, thank you for the lift.
sectorEnter5.3: The Core. Everything from here is a first draft.

bossPhase.1: It just changed its mind about how this goes. Adjust.
bossPhase.2: New pattern, captain. The old one was the polite version.
bossPhase.3: That was a phase change. I would take it personally.
bossPhase.4: It changed pattern. Read it again before you place.
bossPhase.5: New phase. Everything you learned is half wrong now.
bossPhase.8: Watch the intent. It just rewrote itself.
bossPhase.10: It has more to say. Unfortunately.

minibossIntro.1: Gate fight. This one was built to be remembered.
minibossIntro.2: That's not a patrol. That's a statement.
minibossIntro.3: Subsystems visible. Shoot the idea, not the hull.
minibossIntro.4: We don't get past this one by being fast.
minibossIntro.5: It's been waiting at this row for a while, captain.
minibossIntro.6: Whatever it does first, it will do again. Learn it.

kill-raider.1: Clan colours. There will be more of those.

kill-scavDrone.1: Somebody's loader. It didn't choose this.

kill-shieldWarden.1: Fleet escort doctrine. Forty years too late.

kill-jammerCorvette.1: Slot's free again. I hated that.

kill-leechSkiff.1: The dice move again. Thank you.

kill-choirZealot.1: It sang until it didn't. Log the channel.

kill-riftWasp.1: Loud to the end. Check the weapon mount.

kill-breakerDrone.1: Salvage tooling with opinions. Not any more.

kill-magnetTug.1: It only wanted to hold us. It was very good at it.

kill-minelayer.1: Field's still out there. The layer isn't.

kill-riftling.1: The Rift will draw another. It always does.

kill-echoShade.1: It stopped repeating us. Small mercy.

kill-hymnCantor.1: The tempo's gone. The rest will scatter.

kill-coreFragment.1: A piece of the Core, and it bled like a ship.

kill-causalityLoop.1: It stopped swapping. I'd almost gotten used to it.

brittleShields.name: Brittle Shields
brittleShields.desc: Your shield sags by half before the enemy acts.

fatLoot.name: Fat Loot
fatLoot.desc: Drops come a rarity higher; enemies carry 15% more hull.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.desc: The reactor caps two charge lower.

richVein.name: Rich Vein
richVein.desc: Scrap pays half again as much.

wilds.name: The Wilds
wilds.desc: No markets out here. Shipyards only.

resonantStorm.name: Resonant Storm
resonantStorm.desc: One school counts two higher for resonance each battle.

risingTide.name: Rising Tide
risingTide.desc: The interference tide climbs every third jump.

radioSilence.name: Radio Silence
radioSilence.desc: Sensors lose a tier and Echo says nothing.

doubles.name: Doubles
doubles.desc: One extra copy of the lead enemy; every enemy has 30% less hull.

bareHull.name: Bare Hull
bareHull.desc: The Wanderer as it left the yard — no perks, no chart, nothing but the roll.

redHeat.name: Red Heat
redHeat.desc: A deck of nothing but red. Burn a path and do not linger.

iceWall.name: Ice Wall
iceWall.desc: All blue. Outlast the sector instead of out-shooting it.

tightVoyage.name: Tight Voyage
tightVoyage.desc: Every price is half again as high. Spend like it hurts.

batteringRam.name: Battering Ram
batteringRam.desc: The Ram and its Spinal Mount. Hit first, hit once, hit hard.

ark.name: Ark
ark.desc: The Ark's repair bay is the whole plan. Keep the hull whole.

singleCast.name: Single Cast
singleCast.desc: No rerolls, no chart. One roll, one plan, the Rim.

storm.name: Storm
storm.desc: The tide is already rising when you launch.

blindJump.name: Blind Jump
blindJump.desc: Fog ahead and no sensors to cut it. Jump anyway.

choirShadow.name: Choir's Shadow
choirShadow.desc: The Choir under a resonant storm. Lean into the black and pay for it.

keeper.name: Keeper
keeper.desc: Answer every beacon in a single run.

bareArmor.name: No Armour
bareArmor.desc: The shield slots are welded shut.

collector.name: Collector
collector.desc: Nine dice, five schools, one hold.

quietRun.name: Quiet Run
quietRun.desc: Cross the Rift placing as few dice as you can.

2.name: A2 — Empowered elites
2.desc: Elites, mini-bosses and bosses open behind a shield.

4.name: A4 — Deep interference
4.desc: The interference tide caps one level higher.

5.name: A5 — Rewritten bosses
5.desc: Bosses open in their late-fight pattern.

6.name: Overclocked
6.desc: Every elite carries an extra subsystem.

8.name: Extra Verse
8.desc: Every boss phase gains an extra beat.

10.name: The Keeper's Trial
10.desc: Hull −15%. Clear it and the Rim remembers your name.

prologue.drift1: Three weeks of dead space, and the Rim finally coughs up a return. Something big out there, and it isn't moving.
prologue.drift2: You cut the burn and let the hull coast toward the ping.
prologue.salvage1: The fragment comes aboard on a grapple line: a slab of hull with a core still warm inside it.
